summary: Bank locker operation during income tax search proceedings; breach of Section 132(3) IT Act restraint order; FIR for IPC offences including 409 read with 405; whether bona fide bank error v. criminal mens rea; standard: prima facie ingredients must appear in FIR for quashment; High Court's dismissal of CrPC 482 petition upheld; prosecution not barred despite bank's claim of misinterpretation.
final_judgment: Appeal dismissed; impugned High Court judgment allowing investigation to proceed upheld.
